name: sgi-frota
description: SGI Frota — Sistema de Gestão Interno da frota (Matias Brasil Engenharia)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sgi/core && (npm run dev -w @sgi/api & npm run dev -w @sgi/web & wait)
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sgi/core && npm run build -w @sgi/api && npm run build -w @sgi/web
